title: AdaVideoRAG: Omni-Contextual Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Efficient Long Video Understanding
authors: Zhucun Xue; Jiangning Zhang; Xurong Xie; Yuxuan Cai; Yong Liu; Xiangtai Li; Dacheng Tao
why_relevant: Proposes adaptive retrieval routing by query complexity for video understanding, which tangentially touches on control of when/how to retrieve.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is efficiency and accuracy for long-video QA, not robustness to noisy/conflicting/adversarial evidence or calibration/abstention.
